title: A Sudden Message
subtitle: In most cases, code is not suitable for human communication.

items.text: Room 207, Tuesday's Motel
The door creaks as she opens it, and her nostrils are hit with the distinct scent of floor wax.
She flips the switch, and after a brief hum of electricity, the room lights up.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: That man, Stefen. He clearly knows something. But he appears to be rather mentally unstable, and he's hostile towards me.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Madam Z cautioned me on this. I must be extra careful when dealing with people like him. Should make sure I have a backup plan in place before proceeding.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Still no sign of Lilya.
She tries contacting her on her communication device, but the line is busy.
She tries again, but still no luck.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Did she get in trouble?
Suddenly, the phone on the nightstand rings. It vibrates violently.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Hello?

items.speaker: Telephone
items.text: *tap, tap, tap, tap*

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Hello?!
A series of strange tapping sounds comes from the other end of the line.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Erm, is that Ms. Tuesday?

items.speaker: Telephone
items.text: *tap*

items.speaker: Telephone
items.text: *tap, tap—tap—tap*
The short and long sounds are distinct. They form a certain rhythm.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Oh, I think I know what this is.

items.speaker: Telephone
items.text: *tap, tap—tap*

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: That's an R.

items.speaker: Telephone
items.text: *tap*

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: E.

items.speaker: Telephone
items.text: *tap, tap, tap*

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: S.

items.speaker: Telephone
items.text: *tap, tap—tap—tap*

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: P.

items.speaker: Telephone
items.text: *tap—tap—tap—*

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: O.
The phone is abruptly hung up. But it doesn't matter. The thoughts are complete.
RESPOND
A message conveyed through Morse code.
A means of communication that sacrifices efficiency for safety. It's commonly used in intelligence, but rarely for anything else.
Why would there be such a message in a motel?

items.speaker: Telephone
items.text: *ring-ring-ring—*
The telephone rings again. She picks it up without hesitation.

items.speaker: Tuesday
items.text: Hello, is this Ms. Vertin?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Ms. Tuesday?

items.speaker: Tuesday
items.text: Yes. I have an announcement for you.

items.speaker: Tuesday
items.text: There's a service outage going on in the area. Some critters nibbled through the cables of a nearby signal tower. But all our internal phone lines are still running well.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I see.

items.speaker: Tuesday
items.text: It should be repaired soon, since we share the signal tower with that armament factory. I apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

items.speaker: Tuesday
items.text: I'll bring your dinner up later. It's on the house.
Ask about the strange phone call.

branch.speaker: Vertin
branch.text: There's something I want to ask you. I received a phone call earlier.

branch.speaker: Tuesday
branch.text: Oh, Ms. Kimberly was also prank-called not long ago.

branch.speaker: Tuesday
branch.text: I suppose it's a critter's doing—you know how mischievous they can be, and since they have decent smarts, they can play some pretty nasty tricks.
In theory, a group of monkeys could write Shakespeare's complete works on a typewriter if given the time. But would this happen in reality?

branch.speaker: Vertin
branch.text: I don't think that's what made the phone call.

branch.speaker: Tuesday
branch.text: Mm, well, Ms. Vertin, this is what I understand to be the truth.

items.text: Ask about dinner.

branch.speaker: Vertin
branch.text: May I ask what's on the menu?

branch.speaker: Tuesday
branch.text: We have one free meal a day—a ham sandwich and a glass of milk.

branch.speaker: Tuesday
branch.text: If you'd like to have something else, we've also got roast chicken and hummus and a few simple Mexican dishes.

branch.speaker: Vertin
branch.text: Thank you. I'll ask my friend what she thinks when she comes back.

branch.speaker: Tuesday
branch.text: Oh, and the kitchen closes at nine. Please take note of that.

items.speaker: Tuesday
items.text: Is there anything else I can help you with?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I'm good for now. Thank you.
As she hangs up, she feels a light touch on her neck, like a feather brushing against her skin.
She reflexively touches her neck. It's a spider's web. She follows it up to the corner of the ceiling.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Spiders?
A spider falls onto the surface of the wooden cabinet. It moves its slender legs, crawling from one shadowy spot to another.
As it moves, sparks ignite in the air.
Then, in the glow of an arcane skill, she can see everything clearly.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Is that an arcane array?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: The pattern's familiar. I've seen it somewhere before.
The surface of the bedside cabinet has a rough engraving on it. She traces the markings with her fingers, trying to discern their texture and direction.
The array burns her fingertips, and in that momentary pain, memories are awakened.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Yes, I've definitely seen this before,

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: when I was in school.
Classroom, SPDM

items.speaker: Instructor
items.text: This is an extremely dangerous array—one that you are prohibited from using. It can go easily beyond the caster's control.

items.speaker: Instructor
items.text: We study arcanum and tame it for our use.

items.speaker: Instructor
items.text: But once its power surpasses our limits, it is highly likely that it will lead to our own destruction.

items.speaker: Instructor
items.text: I need you all to remember that. It'll be in your next exam.
The students put their heads down, and the sound of scribbling fills the classroom.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Vertin? Are you listening?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: The instructor just said it'd be in the next exam. If you like, you can check my notes.
The top student nervously clutches her notebook in her hands.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Oh, thank you. My mind was somewhere else.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Why have they made it a key point of the exam if we can't even use it?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I see. They didn't teach us about arrays so that we could use them.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: They wanted us to be able to identify them so that we could avoid danger.
She looks out the window. It's getting dark.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: It's highly likely to cause an explosion or other severe consequences if I act too hastily.
The array glows faintly.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Lilya still hasn't come back. I must find someone else to help.
What qualities should an ally have?
Decisiveness, efficiency, some means of offense or self-defense ...
A sudden knock on the door interrupts her thoughts.
She opens it to a familiar face.

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: Hey. We met back in the hallway, remember?

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: Now, it's your turn.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: What exactly do you want from me, Miss?
The mercenary raises an eyebrow.

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: Well, it's simple. The person I'm looking for is right here in this motel, and I'm scouring every corner of it to find her.

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: Look, missy, I don't wanna make things hard for you. Name your price, and we can talk.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: If this person's gone to such great lengths to avoid you, perhaps she doesn't want to see you at all.

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: Well, that ain't my concern, is it? A job's a job. Whether it's catching a cheating spouse, tracking someone down, or delivering a letter, it don't make no difference to me.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Very well. But you'll have to look elsewhere, I'm afraid. There's no one but me in this room.

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: Hah.

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: Look, I know what I'm doing. How about you turn around and take a good look around the room?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: So you can knock me out as soon as I turn my back to you?

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: Hahaha!
The mercenary gives a hearty laugh.

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: Missy, if that were my plan, I wouldn't have spent all this time talking to you.

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: I much prefer to do my business pleasantly. I don't like to see things get too ugly.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I see.

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: Fine. If you don't wanna turn around, I'll tell you what I see.
The mercenary squints, that same emerald light shimmering in her eye.

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: You've burned your finger there. You should be more careful.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: This is ...

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: Don't look like a fire burn to me. What was it? Some arcane energy?

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: Looks like this room has a couple secrets, too.
The mercenary shifts her gaze to the room further away.

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: So you touched an arcane array, and its power burned you. How's that for a guess? Pretty close, huh?
She examines the mercenary's burning emerald eye.

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: This is my arcane skill. It allows me to see the traces that people leave behind. That's how I get these jobs, you see.

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: Ain't nothing happening that don't leave a trace. If there ain't no trace, then it never happened. I came to your room to look for evidence, not a person.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I see. You want to know whether the person you're tracking has been here, right?

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: Now we're talking.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Before I let you investigate the room, I have one more question. You take jobs from people nearby, don't you?

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: Of course. It's obvious, ain't it?
She doesn't get the response she wants. In this familiar silence, the experienced mercenary smells an imminent deal.
It's a mixture of caution and trust, anticipation and doubt.

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: You seem more intrigued by my profession than my peculiar request.

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: You're in trouble, ain't you?

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: Then let me formally introduce myself. The name's Argus, I'm 26, and I have extensive experience as a mercenary.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Let's make a deal.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: You may search this room all you like, and I won't say a thing. But in return, I'd like your assistance in my own investigation.

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: How, exactly?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Can you tell when that array on the cupboard was drawn?
Argus slings her shotgun over her shoulder and crouches down beside the nightstand. After a brief examination, she gives her assessment.

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: Less than 24 hours ago.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: In other words, this was left behind by the last guest who stayed in this room.
Argus shakes her head.

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: Can't say for certain.
